The acceleration and the velocity of the object are perpendicular to each other, so the speed of the object is unchanged. 

We can assume that the mass of the object is also unchanged and since kinetic energy depends on mass and speed, kinetic energy is constant.

question.html:
An object of mass kg  is moving in a vertical circle of radius m at constant speed in an anticlockwise direction. 

a. When the object is at the position shown on the diagram, state the direction of:

i. the object’s velocity.

ii. the net force on the object.

   [2]

The magnitude of the net force that acts on the object is N.

b. Calculate the angular velocity of the object. Include an appropriate SI unit with your answer.

  [2]

c. Determine the kinetic energy of the object.

   [2]

d. Explain why the kinetic energy of the object is constant.

   [2]
